prompt: A vertical 9:16 photograph shot on cheap film with a blunt on-camera flash, in the control room of a grubby British recording studio. Thousands of USB memory sticks hang from the ceiling on strings and lanyards, a dense dangling curtain filling the whole room down to head height, each with a little paper luggage tag, swaying and glinting in the flash. One tag in the foreground is large and legible: "FINAL FINAL". The two men from the reference image push their way through the hanging sticks toward the lens, sticks tangled over their shoulders, faces frozen in horror. Flash-burnt highlights on them, the mixing desk behind fading into darkness. Grain, slightly tilted frame, intentionally imperfect. Thanks.
